_readme: The facts the Chinese legal pages print, as given by the site owner. Only facts the owner provided or that are displayed on the live site are listed here; nothing is invented and nothing is a placeholder. A clause that would need a fact that is not listed here is not written. Entries with ownerStated:true are the owner's own statements that have not been checked against the infrastructure; see docs/legal/zh-legal-review-checklist.md. Draft text, not legal advice.

paymentProvider.note: Wallet top-ups go through the LLM Hub Pay integration in the code.

contactEmail.note: The address the live site already shows (rendered obfuscated as 'contact [at] llmhub.com.cn'). Used for customer service, infringement and complaint notices, and personal-information requests. No other channel is provided.

dataStorageStatement.note: Owner-stated and NOT verified. It conflicts with evidence in the repo and production: the S3 region in .env.production.example is ap-southeast-1, the server shows an AWS default hostname ip-172-31-x-x with IP 13.212.96.236, the Supabase auth project's location is unknown, and the workspace history shows GPT Image and Veo entries routed through the LLM Hub aggregator. See the review checklist, priority item 1.
